pageCache.pageTitle: LEAF Studio School & Sixth Form - Work Experience
pageCache.text:
Work Experience
Work Experience provides a crucial opportunity for the development of vital employability skills. It can take place at any point, but for most it’s something which happens during secondary school education years. For many that week or two will be the first taste of working life.
Work experience provides many benefits, giving young people skills and experience that will allow them to stand out to potential employers as well as helping them choose the right sector to work in. Some will go into Work Experience with a clear career ambition, some will want to sample something they like the look of and for others the experience will be to simply experience work. For all it is valuable experience; developing employability skills is essential alongside traditional academic qualifications to help prepare for life after school, college and university.
At LEAF Studio all students will complete a work experience placement during the summer term in year 10. We have partnered with CSW Enterprise to ensure that all students obtain the best placements possible and have a safe, enjoyable and productive two week placement.
To search for jobs for Year 10 work experience, please use the following link:
https://dorset.learnaboutwork.org/enter-school.asp

pageCache.pageTitle: LEAF Studio School & Sixth Form - Performance Tiers
pageCache.text:
Performance Tiers
High Performance Tier
The High Performance (TASS) tier is specifically designed to support students who are aiming for a professional sporting career alongside a dual-career education. Students who currently compete at a National or International level in their respective sport will qualify for this tier of provision (Academy-signed footballers included).
As a school, we fully understand the demands of high level competition and aim to support those individuals so that they don’t have to sacrifice their education in order to succeed in their chosen sporting field. We acknowledge the pressure of managing the demands of an elite training regime and have put the following provisions in place to support students learning and training equally.
As a High Performance (TASS) Student you will gain the following provision:
Previous High Performance students who attended LeAF Studio can be found on our Alumni page.
Performance Tier
The Performance tier is designed to support students who are aiming for a Semi-Professional sporting career alongside another profession. Students who currently compete at a Regional, County or District level in their respective sport will qualify for this tier of provision.
As a Performance Tier Student you will gain the following provision:
Our aim is to support as many of the students in the Performance tier with their sports performances so as they can push into National level competition. If students are successful with this, they will then be promoted to the High Performance Tier.
Nutritional guidance from LeAF studio staff.
Development Tier
The Development tier is to support students who partake in sport and play at a local or developmental level. The focus of training is not specifically on sports performance, but a generic improvement of a student’s physical, social and psychological performance.
As a Development Tier Student you will gain the following provision:
As a school, we will regularly invite National Governing Bodies of various sports to visit the school and run Talent Identification sessions. If a student is identified as possessing a natural talent for a particular sport, then they will then be invited to training sessions with that National Governing Body for further tests and training.
Nutritional guidance from LeAF studio staff.
Enrichment Tier
The Enrichment Tier is in place to support the students at LeAF who may not partake in competitive sport or fail to meet the attitude to learning expectations of the Sport specialism.
As an Enrichment Tier Student you will gain the following provision:
A Generic Physical Education curriculum (Core PE).
Nutritional guidance from S&C staff.

pageCache.pageTitle: LEAF Studio School & Sixth Form - Home Learning
pageCache.text:
Home Learning
School Vision
LEAF Studio believes that home learning encourages students to take responsibility for their own learning, developing independence along with the skills and attitudes essential for successful lifelong learning.
School Expectation
Each week, each subject will set a Home Learning task that will be planned to last between 30-60 minutes.
Tasks set by subject teachers will be directly linked to the improvement of student attainment and outcomes. These will either be linked to the current week’s learning (consolidating concepts and skills) or as Pre-Learning for the week around (research, key vocabulary). Students may be given resources to aid their exam preparation, revisiting topics from earlier in a subject curriculum.
Tasks set will be of various nature, as suitable to the subject and students’ needs, but could include the following:
All homework will be set & tracked through assignments on Teams by the subject teacher. It will be set on an agreed day with a full week to complete allowing for the teacher to explain task within their lesson, as necessary.
Homework club is available to support all students 3:15pm – 4:15pm Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday after school. Please note there is no school transport available if your child wishes to attend and normally catches a school minibus or coach, alternative transport will need to be arranged.
Students failing to complete home learning will be issued a behaviour point and a one hour after school detention on a Monday. LEAF Studio appreciates our students have many training commitments outside of school. If a student is unable to complete required work, this needs to be discussed with the Head of Specialism & Head of Year and a personalised agreement will be made and shared with staff, if appropriate.
Please click here to see our Home Learning Policy for subject details.
Extended writing tasks based on exam-style questions.

pageCache.pageTitle: LEAF Studio School & Sixth Form - Curriculum Overview
pageCache.text:
Curriculum
Curriculum Intent
As a specialist Sport and Performing Arts Studio school, our aim is for every learner to be able to move seamlessly from LEAF Studio School into employment, professional performance or university, equipped with the necessary skills, knowledge and understanding to purposefully engage in all of the challenges and opportunities they will experience.
Every student who is successful at gaining a place within either our Sport or Performing Arts specialism has to balance dedicated, specialist training with a range of academic qualifications. Our key focus is on Dual Careers – we know that the vast majority of our students will need strong academic grades alongside their specialism qualifications as they progress through their careers.
With this in mind, at Key Stage Four (KS4) we offer the core GCSE subjects including Maths, English and Science alongside our specialisms. Students select from a range of options more relevant to their chosen specialism that are designed to best support their future career progression. Our expectations of academic lessons are the same as at any mainstream school – we expect all of our performers to be as committed to these as they are to their specialisms and the school has a continued focus on delivering quality first teaching and learning across the school.
At Key Stage Five (KS5), the vast majority of students will complete a triple BTEC in their specialisms but there is also the opportunity to study academic A-level(s) alongside. In addition to this, all students undertake additional Strength and Conditioning sessions to support their specialism training as well as undertaking a comprehensive Professional Development programme to prepare them for a future career within their chosen industry. For Sport, we were the first secondary school in the country to be selected for the TASS Dual Career Accreditation Scheme which recognises an education institution’s commitment to dual career support for talented athletes who are in full time education and since 2020, LEAF have been part of the European Network of Sports Schools (ENOSS). We were the first school in the UK to be accredited. This enables us to provide greater links, research opportunities and exchanges with other schools around Europe that offer the same provision as LEAF Studio.
Curriculum Implementation - Key Stage 4
Students transition to LEAF Studio in Year 9 from across Dorset, Hampshire and Wiltshire. Our students study English, Maths & Science as core subjects along with two specialism options.
Year 9 is used as a consolidation year to bridge the gap between the key skills taught in years 7 & 8 from the variety of schools and locations from which they have transitioned, this is designed to ensure the students have what they need in order to be better prepared for their GCSEs.
In years 9 and 10, our Students study English Literature, English Language, Maths and Science for 5 lessons each a week. Each Specialism option block has 2 lessons per week and over 1 hour a week during tutor time is allocated for Personal Development covering topics which make them a rounded individual such as Careers, British Values, Sexual Health and Religious Studies. To add to this, students have 6 lessons of technical training linked to their specialism per week.
In year 11, the curriculum model changes slightly by increasing the specialism option blocks to 3 lessons per week by reducing technical training as well as having 1-2-1 support to assist students who are struggling. We also deliver a range of small group interventions to support students with both Maths and English in Year 11. Over 1 hour a week during tutor time is allocated for Personal Development covering topics which make them a rounded individual such as Careers, British Values, Sexual Health and Religious Studies. To add to this, students have 4 lessons of technical training linked to their specialism per week.The option subjects we offer are:

pageCache.pageTitle: LEAF Studio School & Sixth Form - Careers Information
pageCache.text:
Careers & Work Experience
Our Provider Access Policy statement can be found by clicking here.
Students & Staff
As a LEAF Studio student, you are provided with a range of specialised careers opportunities, including the Move It Performing Arts Convention, the Careers and Apprenticeships Show and various Sports Specialism careers events. At these events, you will have the opportunity to meet with further and higher education providers and employers to broaden your horizons and learn how you can progress in your chosen career pathway. We also provide students with Careers weeks throughout the academic year which teach employment skills and students have a range of assemblies designed to educate and guide them on their future Career options. As a school, we work closely with the Careers and Enterprise Company (CEC) to ensure that we are offering the highest quality provision.
As part of Authentic Education, LEAF Studio students also have access to further Careers Fairs provided by our Trust Secondary Schools. These careers fayres offer a wider range of careers to support any students who want to research careers beyond their specialisms.
In Years 9 and 10, you are able to research careers pathways both in your chosen specialism and beyond using the National Careers Service Job Profiles. You will develop an understanding of the entry requirements and skills required to begin a career in a range of different options through the use of our careers platform, Unifrog. You will also have the opportunity to meet with our independent careers advisor to support you in planning the next steps of your career.
From Year 9 to Year 13 you can expect …
To develop enterprise skills.
To be well prepared for different transitions.
To develop financial capability skills.
Transitioning after Year 11
Please click here for our ‘Choices After Y11’ presentation
Transitioning after Post 16
During Year 13 you will have access to 1:1 support and group sessions that focus on the UCAS and application process for universities and vocational college. Your Specialism Lead will support you every step of the way in securing places at your chosen institutions.
Should your career path change throughout your time at LeAF, our dedicated Careers Advisors will support you with your next steps.
Parents & Carers
Choices After Year 11
At LEAF Studio, we aim to best prepare our students for their chosen pathways or specialisms by providing them with multiple opportunities to meet with a wide range of further and higher education providers. Our students also learn about the range of courses available to them such as: Apprenticeships, T-Levels and Higher National Certificates and Diplomas. and At LEAF Studio we promote vocational colleges and universities for our students through our dedicated UCAS and application support programme and endeavour to provide training and education that supports and meets the admission requirements.
As part of Authentic Education, your child will have access to further Careers Fairs provided by our Trust Secondary Schools. These Careers Fairs will also help support those students who realise that a specialism career is no longer for them.
Careers advice is provided through numerous external workshops, visits and talks from prestigious colleges and universities, as well as apprenticeships and employment opportunities from outside companies. In addition, all students have access to a dedicated, qualified and independent careers advisor for personal careers support over their time with us.
LEAF Studio is proud to have won the 4 Star Award for Employer Engagement and continues to provide opportunities for students to make links with employers locally, nationally and internationally.
Good Practice to Highlight
How do we measure our Careers Programme?
The effectiveness of our Careers Programme is currently measured against the Gatsby Benchmarks and we review our status three times a year using the Careers and Enterprise Compass+ tool.
In Years 9 and 10 through our Personal Development curriculum, students are able to research careers pathways, both in their chosen specialism and beyond using the National Careers Service Job Profiles. As a result, students can evidence that they know and understand the entry requirements and skills required to begin a career in a range of different options.
Students also attend high profile specialism careers events which are directly linked to Performing Arts or Sports. These have included the Move It Dance Convention in London and regular visits to Sporting and Sports Science universities.
All Year 10 and Post 16 students are offered the opportunity to take part in a minimum of 2 weeks work experience, in order to gain direct first-hand experience of the world of work.
Gatsby Benchmarks: Meeting the Mark!
The Gatsby Benchmarks are a key part of the Government’s careers strategy for schools. We are very proud to have received acknowledgement for achieving 100% of the benchmark criteria, which was recognised by the local Careers & Enterprise Company.
The Gatsby Benchmarks have been updated for 2025, LEAF Studio is committed to ensuring that we are consistently compliant with the new guidance and work closely with local professionals and external bodies to achieve this.
To view the Gatsby Benchmarks including the latest updates, please use the following website: The Gatsby Benchmarks
Supporting your child
Labour Market Information (LMI) tells you about what is happening in the job market at national, regional and local levels and includes information about jobs and salaries, what skills employers are looking for in different industrial sectors, conditions, communities and future trends.
It can help you discover where the job opportunities are, the sectors, occupations and locations you need to look out for, and help you identify the skills your child might need to develop in the future.
We use the latest up to date LMI to keep students informed as to the current picture for careers that they are interested in so that they have the necessary knowledge to plan the next steps of their careers. To view the latest LMI for Dorset, please use the following link: Dorset LMI
In addition, it is important that parents and carers are actively involved in supporting their young people in planning the next steps of their careers and helping them understand all of the possible routes that are open to them after their time at LEAF.
Employers & Providers
What can you do?
As a specialist school for Sports and the Performing Arts, we deliver high quality, vocational learning experiences for our students.
In addition to our academic curriculum, we provide opportunities for our students to attend in-house audition days for vocational colleges and trips to universities. We are proud to have outstanding links with many employers, colleges and universities.
If you are interested in creating a link with LEAF Studio and are able to offer apprenticeships, advice or experience for our students please contact the Head of Personal Development: Molly.Hann@leafstudio.co.uk
We would be delighted to hear from you if you can provide any of the following:

Work Experience
Work Experience provides a crucial opportunity for the development of vital employability skills which all students will need for their next steps. Work experience provides many benefits, such as giving young people the skills and experiences that will allow them to stand out to potential employers, as well as helping them navigate their choices after they leave LEAF. For all it is valuable and meaningful experience.
At LEAF Studio, all students will complete work experience placements in Year 10 and in the Sixth-Form. Students are responsible for finding their own placements, though there is a wide range of support available to them.
We have partnered with Unifrog to ensure that all students obtain the best placements possible and have a safe, enjoyable and productive placement. All placements are recorded on Unifrog to allow us to check placements are suitable and have the correct details in place to ensure students are safeguarded effectively when in the workplace.

Our Offsite Partners
We work in partnership with alternative education providers to support their curriculums and exams.

Rockley College
Rockley’s courses are designed specifically for you and allow you to combine your passion for Sport and the Outdoors with a full-time education, whilst also gaining valuable RYA qualifications, skills and experience. With full time FREE fully funded courses available to 16 – 18 year olds, the choice is yours and at Rockley your college course is as unique as you are!
Bournemouth Academy of Modern Music (BAMM)
BAMM provide full time BTEC Level 3 Extended Diplomas in music performance and music technology. Boasting high end facilities, industry links and cutting edge faculty, we equip students with the tools and knowledge required to work in a £15 billion industry.
Dorset School of Acting (DSA)
The Dorset School of Acting is a national drama school. It offers a full time courses for those wishing to pursue a serious career as a professional performer. Both courses are based on using our unique and highly successful approach to acting, “The Process” and gives students the tools to be brilliant performers.
MEPA College
MEPA is a dynamic college dedicated to fostering creativity, performance and excellence in the arts. With a strong focus on developing talent in the fields of musical theatre, singing, dance, and acting, MEPA College offers students rigorous vocational study with practical, hands-on experience.
The college's curriculum is designed to nurture individual artistic expression while emphasising collaboration, critical thinking, and professional development. Through a combination of technical classes, workshops, and live performances, students are given the tools they need to succeed both in the studio and in the competitive world of the arts.

pageCache.pageTitle: LEAF Studio School & Sixth Form - Overview
pageCache.text:
Overview
‘ A Strong Grounding in the Arts’
With a curriculum designed for students aged 13 to 19, LEAF Studio Performing Arts pairs vocational learning alongside compulsory academic studies to equip students with a diverse range of skills and contextual understanding required for our highly competitive industries.
We understand the importance of high quality training and Performing Arts at LEAF provides learners with a strong grounding in the arts, endorsing their growing skillset alongside their current external training providers.
Students will work in a professional environment, experiencing a vocationally relevant training programme, bestowing industry expertise that is delivered by professionals from the Performing Arts disciplines.
Utilising a wide network of tutors, coaches and external links, LEAF Studio are able to provide highly valuable and extensive opportunities for both developing and accomplished students.

pageCache.pageTitle: LEAF Studio School & Sixth Form - Productions and Performances
pageCache.text:
Productions & Performances
We pride ourselves in producing productions to the highest standard.
At LEAF Studio, we pride ourselves in producing productions to the highest standard. We are proud to take our productions to Layard Theatre and Poole Lighthouse and further afield..
From full-scale musicals to intimate vocal events, we offer a plethora of performance opportunities for our students, enabling them to develop as triple-threat performers.
Each year, LEAF Studio students have the opportunity to audition to be part of our Move It Company, taking pieces to the annual Move It Convention at London ExCeL. Performance opportunities in the Showcase Theatre and renowned Main Stage!
Further to this, LEAF Studio attend and perform at the CYD? Super Convention in Liverpool, each year!
Every summer, we produce a variety showcase! This is a fantastic way to end the academic year and to showcase the talent of our students.
All Performing Arts students have the opportunity to be involved in our performances and productions. Students can audition for further roles.
Each specialism area provides performance opportunities respectively in Music (LEAF LIVE!), Dance (Origins) and Acting (Plays).
We strive to have our students performing at every chance, our calendar is always full and continues to grow each term and year!
Please visit LEAF Studio’s social media channels for ticket information.
